meta.title: How we work
meta.description: Diagnose, design, build, launch — then we stay on to keep your system running. Here's how a project with Coshift goes.

hero.title: From the first call to long after launch, here's how we work.
hero.sub: First we understand how you work. Then we design, build and launch your system with you. And after launch, we stay.

start.title: Before you sign anything.
start.intro: Three steps so you know exactly what you're buying.

steps.title: A free audit
steps.body: 30 minutes to show us how you work: your tools, your files, what gets stuck. We tell you honestly what we'd change.

steps.title: A demo and a written proposal
steps.body: We open a demo of your future system on its own secure address, in about two minutes. Then you get a clear proposal: the scope, the steps and the price.

steps.title: A guided launch
steps.body: Once you accept the proposal, we build, move your data over and train your team. Nothing starts without your go-ahead.

after.title: We don't leave after delivery.
after.intro: Your system runs on our infrastructure, and we keep looking after it.

items.title: Hosting
items.body: On our own dedicated infrastructure — or on yours, if you prefer.

items.title: Nightly backups
items.body: Encrypted, stored off-site, with a documented restore procedure.

items.title: Constant monitoring
items.body: We're alerted the moment a service stops responding.

items.title: Updates
items.body: Security fixes and improvements applied, without you having to think about it.

items.title: Support
items.body: One contact who knows your system, because they built it.

items.title: Documentation
items.body: User guides and technical documentation: you know exactly what you own.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the scope: business email is set up quickly, a full ERP takes longer. You get a step-by-step schedule in the proposal.

items.q: Do we have to change everything at once?
items.a: No. We start with what costs you the most, then add the rest when you're ready.
You do. Your data and your servers stay yours, and you get full documentation.
You keep your data, your servers and the documentation. And our systems are built on open-source software, so another provider can take over.

items.q: Which languages do you work in?
items.a: French, Arabic and English — for our conversations, the systems we deliver and the documentation.

cta.title: Let's start with 30 minutes.
cta.body: Show us how you work. We'll tell you what we'd change — free, no commitment.
